content.value: Geometrically interpret the scalar triple product and use it to determine (10) whether the following set of vectors are linearly dependent or not:

$$
\vec { A } = \hat { \imath } - 3 \hat { \jmath } + 2 \widehat { k } , \vec { B } = 3 \hat { \imath } + 2 \hat { \jmath } - \hat { k } , \vec { C } = 2 \hat { \imath } + \hat { \jmath } - 3 \hat { k } .
$$
